ضُمْرَانُ (A 'Obeyd, S, O, K, TA) and ↓ ضَمْرَان , thus, with fet-h, as said by As on the authority of ISk; each of the names of dogs; (TA;) a name of a male dog; (O, K;) not of a bitch, as J asserts it to be. (K.) ＝
-A2- See also the next preceding paragraph.
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
